Depth log-likelihood ratio of a location shift

Source: R/caller_core.R
ll_depth_shift.Rd

log f0(z - mu) - log f0(z): the evidence that a cell-region's window z (log2ratio / pmax(sd_null, sd_floor)) is shifted by mu (a state's log2 shift divided by the same floored sd_null). f0 is the location-scale Student-t fitted to the null z of the row's class x stratum when tpar is given (dt((x - t_m) / t_s, t_df); fit_depth_null()), else N(0, 1) (mu * z - mu^2 / 2). Missing z contributes 0 (no evidence). This is the depth part (dl_loss, dl_gain) of the region score of score_cells().

Usage

ll_depth_shift(z, mu, tpar = NULL)

Arguments

z

window z per row (NA allowed)

mu

shift in z units (scalar or one per row)

tpar

NULL (Gaussian) or the t parameters: a list / 1-row data.table with t_m, t_s, t_df, or the same columns with one value per row

Value

numeric vector (length of z)
